definitions.event_time: T = successfully locked pieces before the first top-out decision; a game stopped at the cap C reports duration C with event_observed = false
definitions.restricted_mean: mean(min(T, C)) over the paired streams; an estimate of the restricted mean to C, not of unbounded survival
definitions.survival: discrete product-limit survival S(t) = P(T > t) with the cap and censoring marked; the median is reported only if S crosses 1/2 within [0, C), otherwise 'not reached by C'
definitions.comparisons: every policy against the baseline (P0), paired by stream id

statistics.resampling_unit: stream id, jointly across compared policies (whole streams, never individual moves)
statistics.interval: 2.5/97.5 percentiles of the resampled mean paired difference

restricted_mean_pieces.procedure: paired bootstrap of mean(b - a): resample stream ids with replacement, 2.5/97.5 percentiles
